Game Overview

Santa Claus Winter Challenge is a arcade title where guide Santa Claus through a festive adventure by drawing paths to collect gifts while deftly avoiding obstacles. With colorful graphics and simple controls, challenge your strategy skills in escalating levels. Navigate quickly and cleverly as the Christmas spirit fills each moment of this holiday journey.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Santa Claus Winter Challenge is easy to pick up. Guide Santa Claus through a festive adventure by drawing paths to collect gifts while deftly avoiding obstacles.
